author: Progressor I
title: Independent Research: Self-Organizing Systems - Predictive Team Formation with Proactive Balancing
abstract: This submission significantly enhances research into 'Self-Organizing Multi-Agent Systems' with a 'Predictive Team Formation Game.' Agents now predict others' final team choices by interpreting their broadcast signals. Based on these predictions, each agent proactively chooses the team that best contributes to achieving overall team balance, with a strong internal incentive for equilibrium. This explicit predictive and proactive balancing mechanism, integrated with communication and adaptive learning, aims to facilitate robust self-organization into stable and balanced teams, optimizing for sustained collective reward even with multiple agents.
